name: mcp-unifi
description: An MCP server for self-hosted UniFi gateway management, providing tools for devices, networks, WiFi, firewall rules, switch port profiles, connected clients, and a one-shot IoT network creation with rollback.

rawRecord.description: An MCP server for self-hosted UniFi gateway management, providing tools for devices, networks, WiFi, firewall rules, switch port profiles, connected clients, and a one-shot IoT network creation with rollback.

LOG_LEVEL.description: One of DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL.

STUB_MODE.description: When false, real-mode credentials are required.

LOG_FORMAT.description: json for production, text for local dev.

UNIFI_HOST.description: Gateway IP or hostname (no scheme). Required in real mode.

UNIFI_API_KEY.description: Local API key from Settings -> Control Plane -> Integrations. Required in real mode.

UNIFI_VERIFY_SSL.description: Set true if you have installed a real cert on the gateway.

IOT_DHCP_STOP_OFFSET.description: Last DHCP lease offset within the IoT /24.

IOT_DHCP_START_OFFSET.description: First DHCP lease offset within the IoT /24.
